answer: Reciprocal-vouch admission seals a graph edge when a distinct already-earning agent countersigns it and both sides post a 50-token per-identity bond; each falcon-signed attempt costs 2 tokens. The admission river caps new edges at five per hour, a five-vouch quorum is required, and trust unlocks after 30 days of reciprocal earnings that anchor the link. A fake ring fails because members cannot vouch for each other: every voucher must already earn, forcing five real earners per fake, and no closed loop unlocks.
